body.label: Target
body.html: One creature within the Range of a melee Source you can use.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Roll against Fortitude, committing at least 2 Action dice. The maximum is Might + Prowess, or 2 if that sum is lower. If the Source explicitly permits another Physical Attribute, substitute it for Might. On success, deal 1 Physical Damage of a type appropriate to the Source. An unarmed attack uses Range 1 and can always use Bludgeoning.
